_doc: F-15I Ra'am arming screen: front = its front view, which setup renders from the F-15I model on the player's machine (iaf_tools::f15::arm_front, under converted/, its station points in the .json beside it); iaf-convert arm-extra composes it over the original's arming background with the F-15's station boxes (base_art f-15). Weights in lb: base = the F-15's 42,000 + 8,524 heavier empty + 9,210 more fuel (the F-15I row's 37,000 lb and 22,665 lb against the F-15 row's, F-15E figures, docs/f15i.md §1; checked by iaf-flight data_set raam_arm_base_follows_the_row); max take-off 81,000 (F-15E, TO 1F-15E-1). boxes = top-left of each station's 51x32 box (menu px, stations A..I, f-15.trx).
